data.body: **[P2] Validate the exact interface method descriptor.** `isAssignableFrom` accepts a stale provider's concrete `SpecificPlugin createPlugin(InvocationInfo)` helper even when it has no compiler-generated bridge returning `DurableExecutionPlugin`. Reflection can select that helper, while `invokeinterface` still searches for the exact erased descriptor and fails, causing the requested provider to be contained and skipped instead of rejected at startup. Inspect all public methods and require a non-static, non-abstract method with the exact parameter and return descriptor; add a stale-class fixture containing the subtype-return helper without a bridge.
